issues.where: f1199 to f1200, 39.97–40.00 s; horizon and field behind the stem
issues.what: The bud and stem hold position, but the horizon steps upward and the grass and field silhouettes lose their registration when the world switches.
issues.fix: Keep the same ground, vegetation positions, horizon profile and advancing camera across the cut; switch the seasonal appearance and lighting in a single frame.

issues.what: The bloom opens like a sweeping reveal: a broad block of folded petals stays locked over the right side of the disk while the left side opens, then the remaining block peels away sector by sector.
issues.fix: Give individual attached petals overlapping but offset unfurling times and distinct bend and twist paths on both sides of the head.

issues.where: 44.37–44.73 s, upper-left junction of green bracts and emerging yellow petals
issues.what: At native size, some narrow green and yellow strips appear to thread through each other at their crossings instead of clearing one another as they unfold.
issues.fix: Resolve contacts between bracts and petals and preserve a consistent front-to-back order and physical clearance along the opening paths.
